summary: Iteration 6 (kernel v4 + App.js split + Espionage + Turn Recap). Kernel ping v4 OK. SAVE_VERSION still 2 OK. Backend: /api/game/{id}/recap route works and returns correct shape (turn, previousTurn, phase, result, winnerIds, log, promiseReports, snapshot, snapshotCount). Missing player_id => 422 OK. Full regression: 38/40 pytest pass. CRITICAL FRONTEND FAIL: MapCanvas.jsx references `isDragging` which is NOT one of its 15 props — this triggers ReferenceError: isDragging is not defined and the galaxy map does NOT render (exactly the 'blank map' hard-fail Grok warned about). Overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors' appears; galaxy-section is absent from DOM, so all downstream tests (info-panel, EspionagePanel, OrdersTray in-game view) cannot be executed via the UI.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with a valid-looking recap for an unknown player_id. Spec requires 4xx (kernel-derived). Backend does not validate viewerId against engine.players before delegating to kernel `recap`, and the kernel appears to tolerate unknown viewerId silently.

recap.snapshot has keys {turn, phase, systems, resources, combat}. Spec explicitly requires snapshot to contain systems / players / turn. `players` is missing (player data is only exposed indirectly via `resources` keyed by player id). Kernel host.ts::recapFor should include a `players` array in snapshot for parity with the spec.

ui_bugs.issue: BLANK MAP HARD FAIL. Line 97 `style={{ cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab' }}` references `isDragging`, but the component receives only 15 named props and `isDragging` is not one of them (it lives in App.js as `const [isDragging, setIsDragging] = useState(false)`). React throws `ReferenceError: isDragging is not defined` at render time; the CRA runtime-error overlay covers the game screen; `.galaxy-section` never mounts; system <circle>/<g> nodes count = 0.

Prop list passed to MapCanvas is missing `isDragging`. Fix: add `isDragging={isDragging}` (and consider adding it to the MapCanvas signature) OR remove/redirect the reference inside MapCanvas.jsx. Without this the entire in-game UI is inaccessible: OrdersTray, EspionagePanel, ResourceHUD, TurnRecap flows cannot be exercised.

rca_of_the_issue: MapCanvas.jsx line 97: `style={{ cursor: isDragging ? 'grabbing' : 'grab' }}`. Prop signature (lines 9–26) accepts 15 named props; `isDragging` is not among them. In App.js, `isDragging` is a local useState on line 67, never passed to <MapCanvas /> (App.js line ~2802). At first render inside MapCanvas, JS resolves `isDragging` against enclosing scope, finds none, throws ReferenceError. React CRA overlay catches it, hides the app. Reproduction: load app -> enter name Alice -> Create New Game -> click Start Game. Mitigation: 1-line prop addition `isDragging={isDragging}` in App.js MapCanvas render + adding `isDragging` to destructure in MapCanvas.jsx. Alternatively derive cursor state internally from a mouse-down ref.
